heading: Step-by-step support
content: Our app guides you through every stage of your process, with the support of our advisors.

heading: Secure and Automated Payments
content: The platform integrates a secure payment gateway managed by Stripe, so clients can complete payments with confidence within the same platform.

heading: Documents, Tasks, and Notifications
content: It includes document review, notifications, and a task system that tells the client which form to fill out, which document to upload, and which files to sign at each stage.

heading: Your LLC Control Center
content: Everything is managed from a clear and secure control center, where the client can track the progress of their process and access their documents in one place.
